title: Focus Session System with Tab Switching Tracking and Progressive Restrictions

requirements.summary: Create focus session setup interface with preset and custom duration options
acceptanceCriteria: User can select from preset session durations or enter a custom duration
Session timer starts counting down when user begins focus session
Timer displays remaining time clearly throughout the session
User can reset or start a new session when current timer completes

file_operations.description: Create a hook to manage focus session timer state including duration selection, countdown logic, start/pause/reset controls, and completion status. Use localStorage to persist active session state across page reloads.

Create a focus session page that displays duration selection interface with preset buttons (25, 45, 60, 90 minutes) and custom input field. Show countdown timer when session is active with clear remaining time display. Include start, pause, and reset controls. Use the useFocusSessionTimer hook for state management and shadcn/ui Button and Input components for UI.
Add navigation link to the Focus Session page in the main navigation menu, positioned between Dashboard and Monitor links.
Register the /focus-session route in the router configuration, making it a protected route that requires authentication.

requirements.summary: Implement tab switch tracking between productive and distractive sections with violation counter
acceptanceCriteria: System detects when user navigates from productive section to distractive section
Violation counter increments only for productive-to-distractive switches, not other navigation
Counter persists throughout the focus session
Counter is visible to user so they can track their violations

file_operations.description: Create a hook to track tab switches specifically from productive to distractive sections during an active focus session. Monitor route changes and increment violation counter only for productive-to-distractive navigation. Store violations array with timestamps and current count. Integrate with useFocusSessionTimer to ensure tracking only occurs during active sessions. On session completion, call backend's recordFocusSession with violation data.

Integrate useFocusSessionViolations hook to display current violation count prominently. Show violation counter badge or card that updates in real-time as violations occur. Display violation history list showing timestamps of each productive-to-distractive switch.
Add FocusSessionViolation and FocusSessionState type definitions including violation count, violation history array, session status, and restriction state.

requirements.summary: Implement three-strike grayscale warning system for distractive sections
acceptanceCriteria: After third violation, grayscale effect applies immediately to distractive sections only
Grayscale effect lasts exactly 2 minutes with visible countdown
Productive sections remain in full color during grayscale period
Effect is scoped to distractive content sections, not the entire app interface

file_operations.description: Add grayscale warning state management that triggers after third violation. Track grayscale period with 2-minute countdown timer. Store grayscale active status, remaining seconds, and which sections are affected. Ensure grayscale only applies to distractive content sections identified by route patterns.

Create a wrapper component that applies conditional grayscale CSS filter to its children based on grayscale warning state from useFocusSessionViolations. Use CSS filter: grayscale(100%) only when warning is active. Display countdown timer overlay showing remaining grayscale time.

Wrap distractive content sections with DistractiveContentWrapper component. Display prominent notification when grayscale warning is triggered showing strike count and countdown. Keep productive content sections unwrapped so they remain in full color.
Add CSS utility classes for grayscale transitions and warning visual states that can be conditionally applied to distractive sections.

requirements.summary: Reset violation counter after 2-minute grayscale period and start new warning cycle
acceptanceCriteria: Violation counter resets to 0 automatically when 2-minute grayscale period completes
User can again accumulate up to 3 violations before next grayscale period
The cycle repeats indefinitely throughout the focus session
User receives clear indication that counter has reset

file_operations.description: Add automatic counter reset logic that triggers when 2-minute grayscale countdown reaches zero. Clear violation count, reset grayscale state, and allow new warning cycle to begin. Track warning cycle number for user awareness. Emit notification event when reset occurs.

Display toast notification using shadcn/ui Toast component when violation counter resets, clearly informing user that they have a fresh set of warnings. Show current warning cycle number in the violation counter display.

requirements.summary: Lock distractive sections until focus session timer completes
acceptanceCriteria: During active focus session, attempts to navigate to distractive sections are blocked
User sees clear messaging explaining why access is restricted and when it will unlock
Lock remains in effect until session timer reaches zero
Productive sections remain fully accessible during the lock period

file_operations.description: Add lock state management that activates after repeated violations or user-initiated lockdown. Implement navigation blocking logic for distractive routes. Store locked status, lock reason, and unlock time based on remaining session duration.

Create a blocking component that replaces distractive content when lock is active. Display clear message explaining restriction, show countdown to unlock based on focus session timer, and provide visual indication of locked status. Use shadcn/ui Card and Alert components for messaging.

Add route guard logic that checks lock state from useFocusSessionViolations before rendering distractive routes. Redirect attempts to access locked routes to DistractiveContentBlocker component. Ensure productive routes remain accessible.
Display lock status indicator showing which sections are currently restricted. Provide clear countdown showing when restrictions will lift based on session timer completion.

requirements.summary: Automatically lift all restrictions when focus session timer completes
acceptanceCriteria: All locks and restrictions are removed when timer reaches zero
User receives completion notification indicating session is complete
User can freely access all sections after session ends
Clear option is presented to start a new focus session with fresh duration selection

file_operations.description: Add completion callback that triggers when timer reaches zero. Set session completed status, emit completion event, and prepare state for new session option. Calculate final focus score based on violation count and session duration before calling backend's recordFocusSession.
Listen for session completion event and automatically clear all lock states, grayscale effects, and violation tracking. Reset to initial state ready for new session.

Display completion modal using shadcn/ui Dialog component when session ends, showing session summary including duration, total violations, and focus score. Provide prominent 'Start New Session' button that resets timer and returns to duration selection interface. Show celebration message acknowledging completed session.

Create a summary component that displays completed session statistics including total duration, violation count, warning cycles completed, time spent locked, and calculated focus score. Use shadcn/ui Card and Progress components for visual presentation.
